title: Host discussed precognition hypothesis with Hal Puthoff

tellings.quote: I spoke to how put off who ran the Stargate the psychic fire program for the CIA

plain: Jesse Michels says he once talked over the idea of precognition, sensing the future before it happens, with Hal Puthoff, the man who ran Stargate, the CIA's psychic research programme. Michels tells this himself, in a conversation with the writer Eric Wargo about prophetic dreams. He raises it because it would mean someone who led the government's own psychic research took the idea seriously.
